definition: A proposal tactic wherein a bidder highlights a competitor's inherent weaknesses or downplays their strengths without explicitly naming them (APMP/Shipley)
golden_rule: Deploy ONLY after firmly establishing the inherent superiority of your own solution
red_lines: NEVER make false or unsubstantiated claims
NEVER cross into arrogance or condescension
NEVER deploy without empirical evidence backing the ghost
An overt attack damages the bidder MORE than it harms the competitor

experience_past_performance.tactic: Define highly specific success criteria that only you possess
experience_past_performance.mechanism: Narrative points out cascading failures when contractor lacks THIS SPECIFIC experience
experience_past_performance.effect: Renders generic industry experience seemingly inadequate
experience_past_performance.example: Our team has completed 12 FEED studies for [exact plant type] in the MENA region, each delivered within 2% of budget — a track record that eliminates the learning-curve risk inherent in first-time regional execution

staffing_resourcing.tactic: Highlight risks of rebadging incumbent staff or using unvetted subcontractors
staffing_resourcing.mechanism: Promote deep bench of proprietary, pre-vetted talent
staffing_resourcing.effect: Casts doubt on competitors relying on external labor pools

size_strategies.small_vs_large: Ghost by stressing agility, single point of contact, personal service
size_strategies.large_vs_small: Ghost by emphasizing depth of technical resources and financial stability

technical_approach.tactic: Identify hidden pitfalls in standard industry methodologies
technical_approach.mechanism: Demonstrate how your proprietary approach actively mitigates unaddressed risks
technical_approach.effect: Makes competitors' standard approaches appear risky by comparison

pricing.mechanism: Explicitly list everything included in comprehensive price
pricing.effect: Forces evaluator to question whether competitor's low bid omits critical elements → future change orders and budget overruns

lexicon_of_doubt.phrasing: Based on industry data, that approach has potential weaknesses because...
lexicon_of_doubt.implication: Forces evaluator to question viability of competitor's standard methodology via objective data

lexicon_of_doubt.phrasing: Rebadging is a high-risk solution in today's competitive job market because...
lexicon_of_doubt.implication: Subtly attacks competitors planning to poach incumbent staff

lexicon_of_doubt.phrasing: Our architecture includes guaranteed uptime, so you never have to worry about losing access
lexicon_of_doubt.implication: Indirectly reminds evaluator of competitor's known system outage history

lexicon_of_doubt.phrasing: What is missing in standard approaches is the following...
lexicon_of_doubt.implication: Educates buyer that lower competitor price likely omits necessary compliance steps

integration_principle: Ghosting subtly educates the evaluation committee, dropping hints that prompt more rigorous scrutiny of alternative bids
